name: steinwall
description: Guardian for coding agents: cost brake, blocks or stops risky actions (recursive delete, force push, secrets, curl|sh), rescues stuck loops, hands work over before usage limits, scans skills/plugins/MCP servers before install. Spend less. Break nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Cost brake, action guard, loop rescue and extension scanner for Codex.
interface.longDescription: SteinWall runs locally next to Codex. It stops runaway costs with a daily and monthly budget, blocks risky actions such as recursive deletes, force pushes, reading secrets or piping downloads into a shell, helps a stuck agent change strategy instead of looping, writes a handoff file before a usage limit runs out, and scans skills, plugins and MCP servers for malicious patterns before they are installed. No prompts, code or keys leave the machine.
